items.title: 眾達-KY自結10月EPS淨損0.46元 單月虧損3200萬元
items.title_en: Zhongda‑KY posts October EPS net loss of NT$0.46 per share, monthly loss of NT$32 million
paras: 光收發模廠眾達-KY(4977-TW)近期股價震盪劇烈，有價證券達主管機關要求，公布注意交易資訊標準，眾達-KY今(27)日盤後也自結財務訊息，以利投資人區別瞭解。眾達-KY自結上(10)月單月稅後淨損為3,200萬元，較去(2025)年同期盈轉虧，每股淨損0.46元，今(2026)年第3季稅後純益2.36億元、年增194.11%，EPS為2.84元。
眾達-KY今年第3季營運大躍升，因受惠今年5月起納入品固集團營收之下，單季營收季增1.79倍、毛利率也翻倍衝上47.44%，累計前3季稅後純益3.56億元、年增28%，EPS 4.39元。
眾達-KY專注於高速光收發模組的研發與製造，目前關注焦點主要集中在400G、800G等高階產品的出貨進度，加上公司在雷射光學封裝領域與博通(AVGO-US)的合作布局，相關產品布局，也成為觀察高速光通訊產業升級的重要指標。
法人指出，眾達-KY今年併購品固集團後，也跨足高精密塑膠及金屬等領域，優化現有產品設計與成本結構，使公司高附加價值之客製化光通訊產品能結合，以提升其他領域供應鏈的各層級客戶，公司自2021年起便與博通合作開發CPO技術，核心產品包括光引擎與外置雷射光源模組。
眾達今日股價受光通訊一片慘綠影響，開高走低終場重挫7.42%收131元，自11月18日波段高點197元算，股價已大跌超過30%以上。
paras_en: Zhongda‑KY (4977‑TW), a maker of optical transceiver modules, has seen its share price swing wildly recently. In response to a securities regulator’s request to publish trading‑information standards, the company released post‑month financial data after market close on the 27th to help investors understand the situation. Zhongda‑KY reported a net loss after tax of NT$32 million for October, turning a profit in the same month of 2025 into a loss, amounting to a loss of NT$0.46 per share. For the third quarter of 2026, it posted a net profit after tax of NT$2.36 billion, up 194.11% year‑over‑year, with an EPS of NT$2.84.

In the third quarter of this year, Zhongda‑KY’s operations surged, benefitting from the inclusion of Pin‑Gu Group’s revenue since May. Quarterly revenue grew 1.79 times sequentially and gross margin doubled to 47.44%. Cumulatively for the first three quarters, net profit after tax reached NT$3.56 billion, a 28% year‑over‑year increase, and EPS was NT$4.39.

Zhongda‑KY focuses on the R&D and manufacturing of high‑speed optical transceiver modules, currently concentrating on the shipment progress of high‑end products such as 400G and 800G. The company’s collaborations in laser‑optics packaging with Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and related product deployments have become key indicators for tracking the upgrade of the high‑speed optical communications industry.

Analysts note that after acquiring Pin‑Gu Group this year, Zhongda‑KY has also entered high‑precision plastic and metal sectors, optimizing existing product designs and cost structures. This enables the company’s high‑value‑added, customized optical communication products to integrate with and enhance supply‑chain customers across other fields. Since 2021, the firm has worked with Broadcom on CPO technology development, with core products including optical engines and external laser source modules.

Zhongda’s stock price was hit hard by a broadly gloomy outlook for optical communications, opening higher but falling throughout the session to close down 7.42% at NT$131. From the November 18 peak of NT$197, the share price has dropped more than 30%.

items.title: 鴻海大語言模型FoxBrain 臺灣主權AI評測奪全球第二
items.title_en: Hon Hai's Large Language Model FoxBrain Ranks Second Globally in Taiwan Sovereign AI Evaluation
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)持續深化AI布局，旗下鴻海研究院自主研發的大型語言模型FoxBrain v2.1，在數位發展部「AI產品與系統評測中心」（AIEC）的「臺灣主權AI基礎評測指標」中，依目前彙整資料排名全球第二。該模型具備31B參數規模，可部署於單台AI伺服器，也讓鴻海AI布局從硬體製造進一步延伸至模型研發與企業端應用。
FoxBrain v2.1此次在國學素養、公民素養及臺灣核心價值觀三項指標的正確率，分別達96.20%、91.37%及98%。其中，臺灣核心價值觀正確率高於目前彙整名單中的所有國際模型；國文科與社會科表現，也分別較其他國內模型最佳成績高約9.4及4.2個百分點。
AIEC評測自2025年3月啟動，持續針對國內外語言模型進行基準測試，並於同年10月首度公布42個模型的評測結果，涵蓋學測國文、學測社會及臺灣核心價值觀三大指標。
在商業應用方面，FoxBrain v2.1參數規模為31B，可在符合硬體及推論設定需求的單台AI伺服器部署，提供企業在自有環境運行模型的選項。相較其他前瞻模型，鴻海指出，FoxBrain僅以約十分之一至百分之一的參數量，即取得AIEC全球第二的成績，凸顯模型在參數效率及繁體中文資料處理方面的研發成果。
鴻海研究院人工智慧研究所所長栗永徽表示，FoxBrain研發重點在於資料建構、模型訓練與對齊，以及符合產業需求的深度推理能力，此次評測讓團隊能透過具體指標檢視研發成果，並與國際模型在相同評測範圍內比較。
鴻海研究院表示，研發過程中自主建構繁體中文資料，並整合模型訓練、對齊及評測，建立從資料建構到模型驗證的完整流程，持續深化資料取得、資料治理及模型調參等核心技術。
對鴻海而言，FoxBrain的進展也反映集團AI技術布局不僅著眼於AI伺服器製造，也逐步向模型及軟體技術延伸，未來可望提供企業更多元的AI部署選擇。不過，現階段公布的評測成績主要反映特定題組與測試條件下的表現，尚不能直接視為模型在各類產業應用的實際效能。
paras_en: Hon Hai (2317‑TW) continues to deepen its AI footprint. Its in‑house large language model FoxBrain v2.1, developed by the Hon Hai Research Institute, ranked second worldwide in the Ministry of Digital Development’s “AI Product and System Evaluation Center” (AIEC) “Taiwan Sovereign AI Baseline Evaluation Index,” based on the data compiled so far. The model has 31 billion parameters and can be deployed on a single AI server, extending Hon Hai’s AI strategy from hardware manufacturing to model development and enterprise applications.

In this evaluation, FoxBrain v2.1 achieved accuracy rates of 96.20% in Chinese classics literacy, 91.37% in civic literacy, and 98% in Taiwan core values. Its accuracy on Taiwan core values surpasses all international models in the current list, while its performance in Chinese language and social studies exceeds the best domestic models by roughly 9.4 and 4.2 percentage points respectively.

The AIEC testing program began in March 2025, continuously benchmarking domestic and foreign language models. In October of the same year it released the first set of results for 42 models, covering three major indicators: the college entrance Chinese language test, the college entrance social studies test, and Taiwan core values.

For commercial use, FoxBrain v2.1’s 31 billion‑parameter size can be run on a single AI server that meets the required hardware and inference settings, giving enterprises the option to operate the model in their own environments. Compared with other forward‑looking models, Hon Hai notes that FoxBrain achieved the global second place with only about one‑tenth to one‑hundredth of the parameter count, highlighting its efficiency and its research achievements in handling Traditional Chinese data.

Dr. Li Yong‑hui, director of the Institute of Artificial Intelligence at Hon Hai Research Institute, said the development focus of FoxBrain is on data construction, model training and alignment, and deep reasoning capabilities that meet industry needs. This evaluation allowed the team to assess their results with concrete metrics and compare the model against international peers under the same test scope.

Hon Hai Research Institute stated that during development it independently built Traditional Chinese datasets and integrated model training, alignment, and evaluation, establishing a complete workflow from data construction to model verification, and continues to deepen core technologies such as data acquisition, data governance, and model tuning.

For Hon Hai, FoxBrain’s progress reflects the group’s AI strategy that not only targets AI server manufacturing but also gradually expands into model and software technologies, promising more diversified AI deployment options for enterprises in the future. However, the published scores currently reflect performance on specific question sets and test conditions and should not be taken as direct evidence of the model’s real‑world effectiveness across all industry applications.

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉央行年底升息？一銀估台灣按兵不動 惟Fed明年Q1前有望升息2次
items.title_en: First Financial Holding’s Earnings Call: Will the Central Bank Raise Rates at Year‑End? Bank of Taiwan Expects No Change, Yet Fed May Hike Twice Before Q1 2025
paras: 針對明年全球總體經濟與台美央行利率走向，第一金控 (2892-TW)今在線上法說會指出，雖有地緣政治與能源價格波動干擾，明年全球經濟成長率仍將維持3.4%，台灣明年經濟成長率亦可望穩守6%大關。一銀副總經理廖文偉預期美國聯準會今年12月及明年3月前仍有各升息1碼的空間，而台灣央行12月雖以維持利率不變為基準情境，但若台美利差持續擴大引發輸入性通膨壓力，仍不排除有跟進升息的可能。
分析全球景氣動向，第一金研究團隊指出，今年雖有中東戰事等衝突影響能源供應，但受惠於企業對人工智慧、高效能運算及雲端服務的強勁投資，加上家庭可支配所得具備緩衝支撐，今年全球經濟成長率預估為3.3%。
展望明年，地緣政治與能源市場的干擾將逐步消化，人工智慧相關資本支出持續支撐復甦，預期全球經濟擴張步伐將更為平穩，全年經濟成長率可望微幅上揚至3.4%。
聚焦台灣經濟表現，受惠於人工智慧應用成長與半導體供應鏈需求強勁，帶動出口與外銷訂單暢旺，加上民間投資持續擴張，今年台灣經濟成長率已突破12%。考量今年基期大幅墊高，明年經濟成長率雖會自然收斂，但在薪資提升與就業市場穩定的支撐下，民間消費動能可望維持溫和穩健，預估明年台灣經濟成長率仍將有6%左右的亮眼表現，整體景氣維持正成長軌道。
在備受市場關注的美國聯準會利率決策上，廖文偉認為聯準會今年12月再度升息1碼的機率相當高，且在明年3月之前，仍不排除有再升息1碼的空間，整體貨幣政策路徑與目前市場主流共識相符。由於美國維持高利率環境的時間拉長，台美利差預計將會進一步往外擴大，這不僅為銀行業的換匯交易操作帶來正向收益空間，也成為影響新台幣匯率與國內貨幣政策的重要變數。
至於台灣央行的利率動向，廖文偉指出，考量目前廣義貨幣總計數年增率仍低於名目經濟成長率，基本情境下預期央行12月理監事會議將維持政策利率按兵不動。然而，若未來美元持續走強，加上台美利差擴大導致新台幣匯率承壓，進而引發輸入性通膨升溫的風險，台灣央行在政策考量上仍會保留彈性，不排除有採取升息措施的可能性，經營團隊將持續密切追蹤國際金融市場變化。
paras_en: Regarding next year’s global macro‑economy and the interest‑rate trajectories of the Taiwan and U.S. central banks, First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) said in today’s online earnings briefing that despite geopolitical tensions and energy‑price volatility, the world’s growth rate is expected to stay at 3.4% in 2024 and Taiwan’s economy should hold steady at the 6% mark. Bank of Taiwan Deputy General Manager Liao Wen‑wei forecasts that the U.S. Federal Reserve could still raise rates by one basis point in December 2024 and again before March 2025, while the Taiwan central bank is likely to keep rates unchanged in December unless the widening Taiwan‑U.S. rate gap fuels imported‑inflation pressures, in which case a hike cannot be ruled out.

Analyzing global economic trends, First Financial’s research team noted that although Middle‑East conflicts have disrupted energy supplies this year, strong corporate investment in artificial intelligence, high‑performance computing and cloud services, together with household disposable income providing a buffer, lead them to project a global growth rate of 3.3% for 2023.

Looking ahead to next year, they expect the geopolitical and energy‑market disruptions to be gradually absorbed, with AI‑related capital spending continuing to support the recovery. Consequently, the pace of global expansion should become smoother, and the annual growth rate could edge up modestly to 3.4% in 2024.

Focusing on Taiwan’s performance, the surge in AI applications and robust demand in the semiconductor supply chain have boosted exports and overseas orders, while private investment remains strong, pushing this year’s growth rate past 12%. Given the unusually high base effect, growth will naturally moderate next year, but higher wages and a stable job market should keep consumer momentum moderate yet steady, leading to an estimated 6% growth for 2024 and keeping the overall economy on a positive trajectory.

On the much‑watched U.S. Fed rate decisions, Liao Wen‑wei believes the probability of another one‑point hike in December 2024 is high, and a further one‑point increase before March 2025 cannot be excluded, aligning with the prevailing market consensus on the monetary‑policy path. A prolonged high‑rate environment in the U.S. will likely widen the Taiwan‑U.S. spread, creating upside potential for banks’ foreign‑exchange trading profits and becoming a key factor influencing the New Taiwan dollar and domestic policy.

Regarding Taiwan’s central‑bank policy, Liao notes that because the multi‑year growth rate of broad money remains below nominal GDP growth, the baseline expectation is that the December policy‑rate meeting will keep rates unchanged. However, if the dollar stays strong and the Taiwan‑U.S. spread widens, putting pressure on the NT$ and raising imported‑inflation risks, the central bank retains flexibility and may consider a hike; the management team will continue to monitor international financial‑market developments closely.

items.title: 不只是車廠 特斯拉獲利能力優於同業 估值指標遠甩通用與法拉利
items.title_en: Not Just a Car Maker: Tesla’s Profitability Beats Peers and Valuation Metrics Far Outpace General Motors and Ferrari
paras: 根據媒體 Benzinga 報導，特斯拉(TSLA-US)在由汽車製造商、豪華車廠商及休閒車生產商組成的汽車產業中營運。儘管同業競爭激烈，特斯拉在多項關鍵估值指標上均居整體產業群組之冠，顯示出資本市場給予其極高的溢價與期待。
Benzinga 提出的估值數據顯示，按當前股價計算，特斯拉的本益比(P/E)高達 422.7 倍，遠高於整體汽車產業中位數的 26.3 倍，明顯超越豪華跑車品牌法拉利(Ferrari)的 37.9 倍。
在股價淨值比(P/B)方面，特斯拉達到 17.0 倍，高於產業中位數的 1.2 倍以及法拉利的 16.2 倍。此外，特斯拉的股價營收比(P/S)來到 13.1 倍，同樣遠高於產業中位數的 0.4 倍與法拉利的 8.5 倍。
這些指標凸顯，特斯拉在資本市場上的估值結構，遠高於傳統車廠如通用汽車(GM-US)及同業基準。
在獲利能力方面，Benzinga 報導指出，特斯拉在過去 12 個月中展現出高於同業平均的毛利率與營業利益率。其毛利率達到 19.3%，優於產業中位數的 9.2%；營業利益率為 3.5%，高於產業中位數的 2.1%；淨利率則達到 3.1%，亦領先產業中位數的 1.5%。
綜合來看，特斯拉雖然在毛利率與營業利益率等營運指標上優於傳統汽車產業平均，但其本益比與股價淨值比等估值指標甚至超越了法拉利等頂級豪華車品牌。
paras_en: According to media outlet Benzinga, Tesla (TSLA-US) operates within the automotive industry, which includes automobile manufacturers, luxury car makers, and recreational vehicle producers. Despite intense competition, Tesla tops the overall industry group on several key valuation metrics, indicating that the capital markets assign it a very high premium and expectations.

Benzinga’s valuation data shows that, based on the current share price, Tesla’s price‑earnings ratio (P/E) is a staggering 422.7 times, far above the industry median of 26.3 times and clearly surpassing luxury sports‑car brand Ferrari’s 37.9 times.

On a price‑to‑book basis (P/B), Tesla reaches 17.0 times, higher than the industry median of 1.2 times and also above Ferrari’s 16.2 times. In addition, Tesla’s price‑to‑sales ratio (P/S) stands at 13.1 times, again far exceeding the industry median of 0.4 times and Ferrari’s 8.5 times.
These figures highlight that Tesla’s valuation structure in the capital markets is much higher than that of traditional automakers such as General Motors (GM-US) and other industry benchmarks.

Regarding profitability, Benzinga reports that over the past 12 months Tesla has posted gross margin and operating margin levels above the industry average. Its gross margin is 19.3%, better than the industry median of 9.2%; operating margin is 3.5%, above the median of 2.1%; and net margin is 3.1%, also leading the industry median of 1.5%.

Overall, while Tesla outperforms the average traditional automotive industry on operating metrics such as gross and operating margins, its valuation multiples like P/E and P/B even exceed those of top‑tier luxury brands such as Ferrari.

items.title: 友達華亞廠找到新買家 售予矽品處分利益估104億元
items.title_en: AU Optronics' Huaya Plant Finds New Buyer, Sale to Siliconware Estimates NT$10.4 Billion Profit
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)今(27)日公告，董事會決議處分桃園華亞廠不動產及相關廠務附屬設施，交易對象為日月光投控(3711-TW)旗下矽品，交易金額197億元，預計處分利益估約104億元。
友達7月底董事會通過出售華亞廠予廣達電腦(2382-TW)，但因雙方對廠房使用規格及交付時程未能達成協議，董事會於10月底決議終止處分案，並另覓買家，今日公告新買家為矽品。
友達此次處分標的包括桃園市龜山區華亞段2筆土地及8筆建物，土地面積約1萬9,741坪、建物面積約4萬9,255坪，另包含相關廠務附屬設施，處分利益約104億元，已扣除相關交易費用及預估稅費。
友達董事長彭双浪先前指出，目前廠房空間已達合適狀態，資產活化將告一段落，未來廠房處分回收資金將作為策略性及未來性投資用途，配合既有三大營運支柱及創新研究院的技術布局，兼顧短中期營運成長與長期技術競爭力。
paras_en: AU Optronics (2409‑TW) announced today (27th) that its board has approved the disposal of the Huaya plant in Taoyuan, including real estate and related ancillary facilities, to Siliconware, a subsidiary of Sunlight Group (3711‑TW). The transaction value is NT$197 billion, with an expected disposal profit of about NT$10.4 billion.

At the end of July, AU Optronics' board approved the sale of the Huaya plant to Quanta Computer (2382‑TW), but the parties could not agree on plant usage specifications and delivery schedule. The board therefore resolved at the end of October to terminate that deal and seek another buyer; today it announced Siliconware as the new purchaser.

The assets being sold comprise two parcels of land in the Huaya section of Guishan District, Taoyuan City, and eight buildings, totaling roughly 19,741 ping of land and 49,255 ping of building area, together with related plant ancillary facilities. The disposal profit is estimated at about NT$10.4 billion after deducting transaction costs and estimated taxes.

Chairman Peng Shuang‑lang previously noted that the plant’s space utilization is now appropriate, marking the end of the asset activation phase. The proceeds from the plant sale will be used for strategic and future‑oriented investments, aligning with the company’s three core operating pillars and the technology layout of its Innovation Research Institute, to support short‑ and medium‑term operational growth as well as long‑term technological competitiveness.

items.title: 高盛拆解機器人產業：中國物理AI迎爆發潮 出貨量2035年將占全球過半
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Breaks Down the Robot Industry: China’s Physical AI Set for Explosive Growth, Shipments to Account for Over Half of Global Volume by 2035
paras: 高盛分析師團隊在名為《物理AI｜中國AI機器人行業研究指南》報告中指出，全球人形機器人產業正從資料採集邁向規模化商業應用。報告預測，中國人形機器人年出貨量將從2026年的約5.4萬台大幅增長至2035年的333萬台，屆時將占全球總出貨量的51%。
高盛將機器人智慧拆解為高層推理(System 2)、動作策略(System 1)與底層控制(System 0)三層架構，其中全身運動控制要求在裝置端實現低於10毫秒的閉環控制。針對物理AI的技術發展，輝達(NVDA-US)創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳解釋，物理AI包含三大計算柱石：「在資料中心訓練模型、在模擬環境中檢驗動作、在機器端執行策略。」
黃仁勳指出，機器人取件不僅要解決「物體在哪裡」，更需根據部件重量與實時觸覺調整握力，才解決「怎樣完整取出來」。受惠於晶片與算力需求，輝達管理層預計其物理AI相關收入在2027財年將超過250億美元。
高盛分析，到2035年中國約95%的人形機器人需求將來自工業、商業與核心消費場景。在工業端，雙臂在整班持續承載15至20公斤，以及關節馬達穩態溫度控制在75°C以下，是衡量硬體能否適配工業環境的關鍵指標。
特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)則表示，擎天柱(Optimus)機器人的實用性取決於機電靈巧度、AI軟體與終端晶片的共同進步。馬斯克認為，危險、重複且可全天候運行的工業崗位將率先體現強勁經濟價值，並預期Optimus可在12至18個月內具備清洗與收納餐盤等家務能力。
高盛將商業化劃分為三階段，預計2027至2029年為客戶驗證期，2030年後才具備單一客戶數千台大單的條件。
在全球20家整機廠評估中，高盛將特斯拉評為唯一能力均衡的企業，波士頓動力與Figure AI等則為領先挑戰者；在2026上半年出貨中，智元與宇樹科技分別佔全球的44%與31%。三星電子等半導體巨頭也計畫於2028年部署機器人以縮短設備檢修停機時間，顯示物理AI正加速推動全球產業自動化轉型。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs analysts, in a report titled “Physical AI | China AI Robot Industry Research Guide,” note that the global humanoid robot sector is moving from data collection to scaled commercial applications. The report forecasts that China’s annual humanoid robot shipments will jump from about 54,000 units in 2026 to 3.33 million units in 2035, representing 51% of worldwide shipments at that time.

Goldman splits robot intelligence into a three‑layer architecture: high‑level reasoning (System 2), motion strategy (System 1) and low‑level control (System 0). Full‑body motion control must achieve closed‑loop response times under 10 ms on the device. Regarding physical AI development, NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) founder and CEO Jensen Huang explains that physical AI rests on three computational pillars: training models in data centers, testing actions in simulated environments, and executing strategies on the robot itself.

Huang points out that a robot picking up an object must not only locate the item but also adjust grip force in real time based on part weight and tactile feedback to successfully retrieve it. Benefiting from chip and compute demand, NVIDIA’s management expects revenue tied to physical AI to exceed $25 billion in fiscal year 2027.

Goldman estimates that by 2035 roughly 95% of China’s humanoid robot demand will come from industrial, commercial and core consumer scenarios. In industry, key hardware metrics include dual‑arm operation for an entire shift carrying 15‑20 kg continuously and keeping joint‑motor steady‑state temperatures below 75 °C, which determine suitability for industrial environments.

Tesla (TSLA‑US) CEO Elon Musk says the practicality of the Optimus robot depends on the combined progress of electromechanical dexterity, AI software and edge chips. Musk believes dangerous, repetitive and 24/7 industrial jobs will be the first to deliver strong economic value, and he expects Optimus to acquire household tasks such as dish washing and storage within 12‑18 months.

Goldman divides commercialization into three phases, projecting 2027‑2029 as a customer‑validation period, with the conditions for multi‑thousand‑unit orders from a single client only emerging after 2030.

In an assessment of 20 full‑system manufacturers worldwide, Goldman rates Tesla as the only company with balanced capabilities, while Boston Dynamics and Figure AI are noted as leading challengers. In the first half of 2026, ZhiYuan and Yushu Technology accounted for 44% and 31% of global shipments respectively. Semiconductor giants such as Samsung Electronics also plan to deploy robots by 2028 to reduce equipment‑downtime during maintenance, underscoring how physical AI is accelerating global industrial automation transformation.

items.title: 〈航運指數〉歐洲線運價強彈 SCFI止跌 航商力拚年約價漲
items.title_en: Shipping Index: European Route Rates Bounce Strongly as SCFI Halts Decline, Carriers Push for Slight Annual Rate Increase
paras: 上海航交所今(27)日公布最新一期上海出口集裝箱運價指數(SCFI)，終結連3周下跌，反彈65.76點至3569.54點，周漲1.88%，儘管美國線運價續弱，反映相對淡季，但歐洲線強彈，航商力拚即將簽訂的歐洲年約運價可小幅上漲。
本周主要航線中，遠東到歐洲每FEU(標準40呎櫃)大漲389美元至3745美元，彈幅多達11.59%；遠東到地中海每FEU更是狂飆893美元至5764美元，彈幅高達18.33%。
遠東到美西每FEU運價續跌354美元至6357美元，跌幅5.27%，遠東到美東每FEU跌514美元，來到8262美元，跌幅5.86%，反映價格衝高後的淡季修正。
目前美西航線運價約7000-7700美元，美東航線約9000美元，均較上周上修，而歐洲航線運價約3000-3500美元，供應鏈瓶頸令供給相對有限、運價淡季有撐。
貨攬業者提醒，歐洲線部分航次雖有 3500美元以下的特價，但目前航商力拚歐洲年約運價可小幅上漲，觀察12月中旬後新年度合約的議價和簽約情況。
paras_en: The Shanghai Shipping Exchange released the latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index (SCFI) today (27th), ending three weeks of decline with a rebound of 65.76 points to 3,569.54, up 1.88% for the week. Despite continued weakness in U.S. routes reflecting a relatively off‑peak season, European routes surged, and carriers are striving to achieve a modest increase in the upcoming European annual contract rates.

Among the main routes this week, Far East to Europe rose sharply by $389 per FEU (standard 40‑foot container) to $3,745, a jump of 11.59%; Far East to the Mediterranean surged even more, climbing $893 per FEU to $5,764, an increase of 18.33%.

Far East to the U.S. West Coast continued to fall, down $354 per FEU to $6,357, a decline of 5.27%, while Far East to the U.S. East Coast dropped $514 per FEU to $8,262, a 5.86% decrease, reflecting a seasonal correction after price peaks.

Current rates are roughly $7,000‑$7,700 for the West Coast route and about $9,000 for the East Coast route, both revised upward from last week, while European route rates sit around $3,000‑$3,500, with supply‑chain bottlenecks limiting supply and supporting off‑peak pricing.

Freight forwarders note that some European sailings still offer special rates below $3,500, but carriers are pushing for a slight increase in European annual contract rates and will monitor pricing and signing activity for new contracts after mid‑December.

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉現金股利配發保底6成！一銀喊台股修正是買點 明年SWAP上看127億
items.title_en: First Financial Holding Earnings Call: Cash Dividend Payout Targeted at Over 60% – Bank of Taiwan Calls Taiwan Stock Pullback a Buying Opportunity, Next Year SWAP Revenue Could Reach NT$12.7 Billion
paras: 第一金控 (2892-TW) 今(27) 日召開線上法人說明會，由第一金副總莊淑娟、一銀副總朱芙蓉主持，針對存股族最關心的股利政策釋出明確方向，強調未來將以發放現金股利為主，以現金配發率60%以上為目標，是否配股尚需討論。面對近期台股震盪修正，第一銀行副總經理廖文偉定調為逢低布局的絕佳契機，估明年換匯交易收益持續放大，上看127億元，同時推動證券與人壽等非銀行子公司獲利佔比突破15%大關。
針對股利發放規劃，莊淑娟表示，公司向來重視對股東的長期回饋，股利政策維持以現金股利為主軸，原則上設定現金配發率60%以上為目標，實際配發水準將綜合考量整體子公司盈餘上繳狀況、未來業務拓展需求以及資本適足率規劃來決定。至於明年是否會發放股票股利，目前各子公司與金控仍在進行年度預算與資本規劃的討論階段，尚未定案，將致力於以對股東最有利的方式進行回饋。
在財務操作與投資布局方面，廖文偉指出，今年台灣經濟成長率預估達11%至12%，明年仍有5.5%至6%的穩健表現，受惠於人工智慧與半導體產業趨勢向上，近期台股出現修正反而讓許多優質個股的投資價值浮現，成為逢低承接的好機會。
廖文偉表示，目前第一銀行股票部位約在200多億元至300多億元之間動態調整，逢高適度調節獲利，逢低則進場布局，操作上兼具靈活性與收益考量，並不會受到流動性覆蓋比率的排擠。
在換匯交易收益表現上，廖文偉說明，今年前10月第一金換匯交易收益已達約90億元，今年全年可望挑戰105億元水準。展望明年，由於台美差預期仍將持續擴大，換匯交易收益動能看俏，預估明年全年收益區間將進一步攀升至125億元至127億元。
而在整體金控獲利動能方面，由於今年資本市場熱絡墊高基期，今年前9月每股盈餘年增率高達19.6%，明年整體獲利成長目標將以貼近國內經濟成長率的6%左右為合理基準。
此外，為強化雙引擎獲利結構，第一金積極拉升非銀行子公司的獲利貢獻。今年截至9月底，第一金證券獲利已達20億元，第一金人壽獲利也來到約6.5億元，帶動非銀行子公司整體獲利佔比提升至13%至14%區間。
展望明年，金控內部對證券與人壽設定雙位數的高成長目標，期盼明年非銀行子公司獲利佔比能正式突破15%，並審慎評估透過增資或拓展外部通路擴大營運規模。
paras_en: First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) held an online analyst briefing today (27th), hosted by Deputy General Manager Zhuang Shujian and Deputy General Manager Zhu Furong of Bank of Taiwan. They gave clear guidance on dividend policy, emphasizing that cash dividends will be the primary focus going forward, with a target cash payout ratio of over 60%. Whether stock dividends will be issued remains under discussion. In light of recent volatility in Taiwan stocks, Deputy General Manager Liao Wen‑wei of Bank of Taiwan sees a prime buying opportunity on dips, forecasting next‑year foreign‑exchange transaction earnings to expand to about NT$12.7 billion, while aiming for non‑bank subsidiaries such as securities and life insurance to exceed a 15% profit contribution share.

Regarding dividend plans, Zhuang Shujian said the company has always valued long‑term returns to shareholders and will maintain cash dividends as the core policy, setting a cash payout ratio of at least 60% as a principle. The actual payout level will consider the overall subsidiaries’ earnings contributions, future business expansion needs, and capital adequacy planning. As for stock dividends next year, each subsidiary and the holding company are still discussing annual budgets and capital plans, with no decision yet, and the company will strive to return value to shareholders in the most beneficial way.

On financial operations and investment positioning, Liao Wen‑wei noted that Taiwan’s economy is projected to grow 11%‑12% this year and maintain a solid 5.5%‑6% growth next year, buoyed by AI and semiconductor trends. The recent market correction has highlighted the investment value of many quality stocks, creating a good opportunity to buy on lows.

Liao added that the bank’s equity holdings currently range dynamically between NT$200 billion and NT$300 billion. The strategy is to modestly trim positions on rallies and add on dips, balancing flexibility with return considerations, and it will not be constrained by liquidity coverage ratio pressures.

Regarding foreign‑exchange transaction earnings, Liao explained that for the first ten months of this year First Financial’s FX trading profit has reached about NT$9 billion, and the full‑year target is around NT$10.5 billion. Looking ahead, with the Taiwan‑U.S. rate differential expected to widen further, the momentum is strong and the full‑year FY2025 earnings are projected to climb to a range of NT$12.5 billion‑NT$12.7 billion.

On overall holding‑company profit momentum, a strong capital‑market environment lifted the base this year, delivering a year‑over‑year EPS growth of 19.6% for the first nine months. The profit‑growth target for next year is set around 6%, roughly in line with domestic economic growth.

To strengthen its dual‑engine profit structure, First Financial is actively boosting contributions from non‑bank subsidiaries. As of the end of September, First Financial Securities posted NT$2 billion in profit and First Financial Life reported about NT$650 million, raising the overall non‑bank profit share to between 13% and 14%.

Looking ahead to next year, the holding company has set double‑digit growth targets for its securities and life‑insurance arms, hoping the non‑bank profit share will officially surpass 15%. It will also carefully evaluate capital increases or expanding external distribution channels to enlarge its operating scale.

items.title: 眾達-KY自結10月EPS淨損0.46元 單月虧損3200萬元
items.title_en: Zhongda‑KY posts October EPS net loss of NT$0.46 per share, monthly loss of NT$32 million
paras: 光收發模廠眾達-KY(4977-TW)近期股價震盪劇烈，有價證券達主管機關要求，公布注意交易資訊標準，眾達-KY今(27)日盤後也自結財務訊息，以利投資人區別瞭解。眾達-KY自結上(10)月單月稅後淨損為3,200萬元，較去(2025)年同期盈轉虧，每股淨損0.46元，今(2026)年第3季稅後純益2.36億元、年增194.11%，EPS為2.84元。
眾達-KY今年第3季營運大躍升，因受惠今年5月起納入品固集團營收之下，單季營收季增1.79倍、毛利率也翻倍衝上47.44%，累計前3季稅後純益3.56億元、年增28%，EPS 4.39元。
眾達-KY專注於高速光收發模組的研發與製造，目前關注焦點主要集中在400G、800G等高階產品的出貨進度，加上公司在雷射光學封裝領域與博通(AVGO-US)的合作布局，相關產品布局，也成為觀察高速光通訊產業升級的重要指標。
法人指出，眾達-KY今年併購品固集團後，也跨足高精密塑膠及金屬等領域，優化現有產品設計與成本結構，使公司高附加價值之客製化光通訊產品能結合，以提升其他領域供應鏈的各層級客戶，公司自2021年起便與博通合作開發CPO技術，核心產品包括光引擎與外置雷射光源模組。
眾達今日股價受光通訊一片慘綠影響，開高走低終場重挫7.42%收131元，自11月18日波段高點197元算，股價已大跌超過30%以上。
paras_en: Zhongda‑KY (4977‑TW), a maker of optical transceiver modules, has seen its share price swing wildly recently. In response to a securities regulator’s request to publish trading‑information standards, the company released post‑month financial data after market close on the 27th to help investors understand the situation. Zhongda‑KY reported a net loss after tax of NT$32 million for October, turning a profit in the same month of 2025 into a loss, amounting to a loss of NT$0.46 per share. For the third quarter of 2026, it posted a net profit after tax of NT$2.36 billion, up 194.11% year‑over‑year, with an EPS of NT$2.84.

In the third quarter of this year, Zhongda‑KY’s operations surged, benefitting from the inclusion of Pin‑Gu Group’s revenue since May. Quarterly revenue grew 1.79 times sequentially and gross margin doubled to 47.44%. Cumulatively for the first three quarters, net profit after tax reached NT$3.56 billion, a 28% year‑over‑year increase, and EPS was NT$4.39.

Zhongda‑KY focuses on the R&D and manufacturing of high‑speed optical transceiver modules, currently concentrating on the shipment progress of high‑end products such as 400G and 800G. The company’s collaborations in laser‑optics packaging with Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and related product deployments have become key indicators for tracking the upgrade of the high‑speed optical communications industry.

Analysts note that after acquiring Pin‑Gu Group this year, Zhongda‑KY has also entered high‑precision plastic and metal sectors, optimizing existing product designs and cost structures. This enables the company’s high‑value‑added, customized optical communication products to integrate with and enhance supply‑chain customers across other fields. Since 2021, the firm has worked with Broadcom on CPO technology development, with core products including optical engines and external laser source modules.

Zhongda’s stock price was hit hard by a broadly gloomy outlook for optical communications, opening higher but falling throughout the session to close down 7.42% at NT$131. From the November 18 peak of NT$197, the share price has dropped more than 30%.

items.title: 鴻海大語言模型FoxBrain 臺灣主權AI評測奪全球第二
items.title_en: Hon Hai's Large Language Model FoxBrain Ranks Second Globally in Taiwan Sovereign AI Evaluation
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)持續深化AI布局，旗下鴻海研究院自主研發的大型語言模型FoxBrain v2.1，在數位發展部「AI產品與系統評測中心」（AIEC）的「臺灣主權AI基礎評測指標」中，依目前彙整資料排名全球第二。該模型具備31B參數規模，可部署於單台AI伺服器，也讓鴻海AI布局從硬體製造進一步延伸至模型研發與企業端應用。
FoxBrain v2.1此次在國學素養、公民素養及臺灣核心價值觀三項指標的正確率，分別達96.20%、91.37%及98%。其中，臺灣核心價值觀正確率高於目前彙整名單中的所有國際模型；國文科與社會科表現，也分別較其他國內模型最佳成績高約9.4及4.2個百分點。
AIEC評測自2025年3月啟動，持續針對國內外語言模型進行基準測試，並於同年10月首度公布42個模型的評測結果，涵蓋學測國文、學測社會及臺灣核心價值觀三大指標。
在商業應用方面，FoxBrain v2.1參數規模為31B，可在符合硬體及推論設定需求的單台AI伺服器部署，提供企業在自有環境運行模型的選項。相較其他前瞻模型，鴻海指出，FoxBrain僅以約十分之一至百分之一的參數量，即取得AIEC全球第二的成績，凸顯模型在參數效率及繁體中文資料處理方面的研發成果。
鴻海研究院人工智慧研究所所長栗永徽表示，FoxBrain研發重點在於資料建構、模型訓練與對齊，以及符合產業需求的深度推理能力，此次評測讓團隊能透過具體指標檢視研發成果，並與國際模型在相同評測範圍內比較。
鴻海研究院表示，研發過程中自主建構繁體中文資料，並整合模型訓練、對齊及評測，建立從資料建構到模型驗證的完整流程，持續深化資料取得、資料治理及模型調參等核心技術。
對鴻海而言，FoxBrain的進展也反映集團AI技術布局不僅著眼於AI伺服器製造，也逐步向模型及軟體技術延伸，未來可望提供企業更多元的AI部署選擇。不過，現階段公布的評測成績主要反映特定題組與測試條件下的表現，尚不能直接視為模型在各類產業應用的實際效能。
paras_en: Hon Hai (2317‑TW) continues to deepen its AI footprint. Its in‑house large language model FoxBrain v2.1, developed by the Hon Hai Research Institute, ranked second worldwide in the Ministry of Digital Development’s “AI Product and System Evaluation Center” (AIEC) “Taiwan Sovereign AI Baseline Evaluation Index,” based on the data compiled so far. The model has 31 billion parameters and can be deployed on a single AI server, extending Hon Hai’s AI strategy from hardware manufacturing to model development and enterprise applications.

In this evaluation, FoxBrain v2.1 achieved accuracy rates of 96.20% in Chinese classics literacy, 91.37% in civic literacy, and 98% in Taiwan core values. Its accuracy on Taiwan core values surpasses all international models in the current list, while its performance in Chinese language and social studies exceeds the best domestic models by roughly 9.4 and 4.2 percentage points respectively.

The AIEC testing program began in March 2025, continuously benchmarking domestic and foreign language models. In October of the same year it released the first set of results for 42 models, covering three major indicators: the college entrance Chinese language test, the college entrance social studies test, and Taiwan core values.

For commercial use, FoxBrain v2.1’s 31 billion‑parameter size can be run on a single AI server that meets the required hardware and inference settings, giving enterprises the option to operate the model in their own environments. Compared with other forward‑looking models, Hon Hai notes that FoxBrain achieved the global second place with only about one‑tenth to one‑hundredth of the parameter count, highlighting its efficiency and its research achievements in handling Traditional Chinese data.

Dr. Li Yong‑hui, director of the Institute of Artificial Intelligence at Hon Hai Research Institute, said the development focus of FoxBrain is on data construction, model training and alignment, and deep reasoning capabilities that meet industry needs. This evaluation allowed the team to assess their results with concrete metrics and compare the model against international peers under the same test scope.

Hon Hai Research Institute stated that during development it independently built Traditional Chinese datasets and integrated model training, alignment, and evaluation, establishing a complete workflow from data construction to model verification, and continues to deepen core technologies such as data acquisition, data governance, and model tuning.

For Hon Hai, FoxBrain’s progress reflects the group’s AI strategy that not only targets AI server manufacturing but also gradually expands into model and software technologies, promising more diversified AI deployment options for enterprises in the future. However, the published scores currently reflect performance on specific question sets and test conditions and should not be taken as direct evidence of the model’s real‑world effectiveness across all industry applications.

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉央行年底升息？一銀估台灣按兵不動 惟Fed明年Q1前有望升息2次
items.title_en: First Financial Holding’s Earnings Call: Will the Central Bank Raise Rates at Year‑End? Bank of Taiwan Expects No Change, Yet Fed May Hike Twice Before Q1 2025
paras: 針對明年全球總體經濟與台美央行利率走向，第一金控 (2892-TW)今在線上法說會指出，雖有地緣政治與能源價格波動干擾，明年全球經濟成長率仍將維持3.4%，台灣明年經濟成長率亦可望穩守6%大關。一銀副總經理廖文偉預期美國聯準會今年12月及明年3月前仍有各升息1碼的空間，而台灣央行12月雖以維持利率不變為基準情境，但若台美利差持續擴大引發輸入性通膨壓力，仍不排除有跟進升息的可能。
分析全球景氣動向，第一金研究團隊指出，今年雖有中東戰事等衝突影響能源供應，但受惠於企業對人工智慧、高效能運算及雲端服務的強勁投資，加上家庭可支配所得具備緩衝支撐，今年全球經濟成長率預估為3.3%。
展望明年，地緣政治與能源市場的干擾將逐步消化，人工智慧相關資本支出持續支撐復甦，預期全球經濟擴張步伐將更為平穩，全年經濟成長率可望微幅上揚至3.4%。
聚焦台灣經濟表現，受惠於人工智慧應用成長與半導體供應鏈需求強勁，帶動出口與外銷訂單暢旺，加上民間投資持續擴張，今年台灣經濟成長率已突破12%。考量今年基期大幅墊高，明年經濟成長率雖會自然收斂，但在薪資提升與就業市場穩定的支撐下，民間消費動能可望維持溫和穩健，預估明年台灣經濟成長率仍將有6%左右的亮眼表現，整體景氣維持正成長軌道。
在備受市場關注的美國聯準會利率決策上，廖文偉認為聯準會今年12月再度升息1碼的機率相當高，且在明年3月之前，仍不排除有再升息1碼的空間，整體貨幣政策路徑與目前市場主流共識相符。由於美國維持高利率環境的時間拉長，台美利差預計將會進一步往外擴大，這不僅為銀行業的換匯交易操作帶來正向收益空間，也成為影響新台幣匯率與國內貨幣政策的重要變數。
至於台灣央行的利率動向，廖文偉指出，考量目前廣義貨幣總計數年增率仍低於名目經濟成長率，基本情境下預期央行12月理監事會議將維持政策利率按兵不動。然而，若未來美元持續走強，加上台美利差擴大導致新台幣匯率承壓，進而引發輸入性通膨升溫的風險，台灣央行在政策考量上仍會保留彈性，不排除有採取升息措施的可能性，經營團隊將持續密切追蹤國際金融市場變化。
paras_en: Regarding next year’s global macro‑economy and the interest‑rate trajectories of the Taiwan and U.S. central banks, First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) said in today’s online earnings briefing that despite geopolitical tensions and energy‑price volatility, the world’s growth rate is expected to stay at 3.4% in 2024 and Taiwan’s economy should hold steady at the 6% mark. Bank of Taiwan Deputy General Manager Liao Wen‑wei forecasts that the U.S. Federal Reserve could still raise rates by one basis point in December 2024 and again before March 2025, while the Taiwan central bank is likely to keep rates unchanged in December unless the widening Taiwan‑U.S. rate gap fuels imported‑inflation pressures, in which case a hike cannot be ruled out.

Analyzing global economic trends, First Financial’s research team noted that although Middle‑East conflicts have disrupted energy supplies this year, strong corporate investment in artificial intelligence, high‑performance computing and cloud services, together with household disposable income providing a buffer, lead them to project a global growth rate of 3.3% for 2023.

Looking ahead to next year, they expect the geopolitical and energy‑market disruptions to be gradually absorbed, with AI‑related capital spending continuing to support the recovery. Consequently, the pace of global expansion should become smoother, and the annual growth rate could edge up modestly to 3.4% in 2024.

Focusing on Taiwan’s performance, the surge in AI applications and robust demand in the semiconductor supply chain have boosted exports and overseas orders, while private investment remains strong, pushing this year’s growth rate past 12%. Given the unusually high base effect, growth will naturally moderate next year, but higher wages and a stable job market should keep consumer momentum moderate yet steady, leading to an estimated 6% growth for 2024 and keeping the overall economy on a positive trajectory.

On the much‑watched U.S. Fed rate decisions, Liao Wen‑wei believes the probability of another one‑point hike in December 2024 is high, and a further one‑point increase before March 2025 cannot be excluded, aligning with the prevailing market consensus on the monetary‑policy path. A prolonged high‑rate environment in the U.S. will likely widen the Taiwan‑U.S. spread, creating upside potential for banks’ foreign‑exchange trading profits and becoming a key factor influencing the New Taiwan dollar and domestic policy.

Regarding Taiwan’s central‑bank policy, Liao notes that because the multi‑year growth rate of broad money remains below nominal GDP growth, the baseline expectation is that the December policy‑rate meeting will keep rates unchanged. However, if the dollar stays strong and the Taiwan‑U.S. spread widens, putting pressure on the NT$ and raising imported‑inflation risks, the central bank retains flexibility and may consider a hike; the management team will continue to monitor international financial‑market developments closely.

items.title: 友達華亞廠找到新買家 售予矽品處分利益估104億元
items.title_en: AU Optronics' Huaya Plant Finds New Buyer, Sale to Siliconware Estimates NT$10.4 Billion Profit
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)今(27)日公告，董事會決議處分桃園華亞廠不動產及相關廠務附屬設施，交易對象為日月光投控(3711-TW)旗下矽品，交易金額197億元，預計處分利益估約104億元。
友達7月底董事會通過出售華亞廠予廣達電腦(2382-TW)，但因雙方對廠房使用規格及交付時程未能達成協議，董事會於10月底決議終止處分案，並另覓買家，今日公告新買家為矽品。
友達此次處分標的包括桃園市龜山區華亞段2筆土地及8筆建物，土地面積約1萬9,741坪、建物面積約4萬9,255坪，另包含相關廠務附屬設施，處分利益約104億元，已扣除相關交易費用及預估稅費。
友達董事長彭双浪先前指出，目前廠房空間已達合適狀態，資產活化將告一段落，未來廠房處分回收資金將作為策略性及未來性投資用途，配合既有三大營運支柱及創新研究院的技術布局，兼顧短中期營運成長與長期技術競爭力。
paras_en: AU Optronics (2409‑TW) announced today (27th) that its board has approved the disposal of the Huaya plant in Taoyuan, including real estate and related ancillary facilities, to Siliconware, a subsidiary of Sunlight Group (3711‑TW). The transaction value is NT$197 billion, with an expected disposal profit of about NT$10.4 billion.

At the end of July, AU Optronics' board approved the sale of the Huaya plant to Quanta Computer (2382‑TW), but the parties could not agree on plant usage specifications and delivery schedule. The board therefore resolved at the end of October to terminate that deal and seek another buyer; today it announced Siliconware as the new purchaser.

The assets being sold comprise two parcels of land in the Huaya section of Guishan District, Taoyuan City, and eight buildings, totaling roughly 19,741 ping of land and 49,255 ping of building area, together with related plant ancillary facilities. The disposal profit is estimated at about NT$10.4 billion after deducting transaction costs and estimated taxes.

Chairman Peng Shuang‑lang previously noted that the plant’s space utilization is now appropriate, marking the end of the asset activation phase. The proceeds from the plant sale will be used for strategic and future‑oriented investments, aligning with the company’s three core operating pillars and the technology layout of its Innovation Research Institute, to support short‑ and medium‑term operational growth as well as long‑term technological competitiveness.

items.title: 〈航運指數〉歐洲線運價強彈 SCFI止跌 航商力拚年約價漲
items.title_en: Shipping Index: European Route Rates Bounce Strongly as SCFI Halts Decline, Carriers Push for Slight Annual Rate Increase
paras: 上海航交所今(27)日公布最新一期上海出口集裝箱運價指數(SCFI)，終結連3周下跌，反彈65.76點至3569.54點，周漲1.88%，儘管美國線運價續弱，反映相對淡季，但歐洲線強彈，航商力拚即將簽訂的歐洲年約運價可小幅上漲。
本周主要航線中，遠東到歐洲每FEU(標準40呎櫃)大漲389美元至3745美元，彈幅多達11.59%；遠東到地中海每FEU更是狂飆893美元至5764美元，彈幅高達18.33%。
遠東到美西每FEU運價續跌354美元至6357美元，跌幅5.27%，遠東到美東每FEU跌514美元，來到8262美元，跌幅5.86%，反映價格衝高後的淡季修正。
目前美西航線運價約7000-7700美元，美東航線約9000美元，均較上周上修，而歐洲航線運價約3000-3500美元，供應鏈瓶頸令供給相對有限、運價淡季有撐。
貨攬業者提醒，歐洲線部分航次雖有 3500美元以下的特價，但目前航商力拚歐洲年約運價可小幅上漲，觀察12月中旬後新年度合約的議價和簽約情況。
paras_en: The Shanghai Shipping Exchange released the latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index (SCFI) today (27th), ending three weeks of decline with a rebound of 65.76 points to 3,569.54, up 1.88% for the week. Despite continued weakness in U.S. routes reflecting a relatively off‑peak season, European routes surged, and carriers are striving to achieve a modest increase in the upcoming European annual contract rates.

Among the main routes this week, Far East to Europe rose sharply by $389 per FEU (standard 40‑foot container) to $3,745, a jump of 11.59%; Far East to the Mediterranean surged even more, climbing $893 per FEU to $5,764, an increase of 18.33%.

Far East to the U.S. West Coast continued to fall, down $354 per FEU to $6,357, a decline of 5.27%, while Far East to the U.S. East Coast dropped $514 per FEU to $8,262, a 5.86% decrease, reflecting a seasonal correction after price peaks.

Current rates are roughly $7,000‑$7,700 for the West Coast route and about $9,000 for the East Coast route, both revised upward from last week, while European route rates sit around $3,000‑$3,500, with supply‑chain bottlenecks limiting supply and supporting off‑peak pricing.

Freight forwarders note that some European sailings still offer special rates below $3,500, but carriers are pushing for a slight increase in European annual contract rates and will monitor pricing and signing activity for new contracts after mid‑December.

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉現金股利配發保底6成！一銀喊台股修正是買點 明年SWAP上看127億
items.title_en: First Financial Holding Earnings Call: Cash Dividend Payout Targeted at Over 60% – Bank of Taiwan Calls Taiwan Stock Pullback a Buying Opportunity, Next Year SWAP Revenue Could Reach NT$12.7 Billion
paras: 第一金控 (2892-TW) 今(27) 日召開線上法人說明會，由第一金副總莊淑娟、一銀副總朱芙蓉主持，針對存股族最關心的股利政策釋出明確方向，強調未來將以發放現金股利為主，以現金配發率60%以上為目標，是否配股尚需討論。面對近期台股震盪修正，第一銀行副總經理廖文偉定調為逢低布局的絕佳契機，估明年換匯交易收益持續放大，上看127億元，同時推動證券與人壽等非銀行子公司獲利佔比突破15%大關。
針對股利發放規劃，莊淑娟表示，公司向來重視對股東的長期回饋，股利政策維持以現金股利為主軸，原則上設定現金配發率60%以上為目標，實際配發水準將綜合考量整體子公司盈餘上繳狀況、未來業務拓展需求以及資本適足率規劃來決定。至於明年是否會發放股票股利，目前各子公司與金控仍在進行年度預算與資本規劃的討論階段，尚未定案，將致力於以對股東最有利的方式進行回饋。
在財務操作與投資布局方面，廖文偉指出，今年台灣經濟成長率預估達11%至12%，明年仍有5.5%至6%的穩健表現，受惠於人工智慧與半導體產業趨勢向上，近期台股出現修正反而讓許多優質個股的投資價值浮現，成為逢低承接的好機會。
廖文偉表示，目前第一銀行股票部位約在200多億元至300多億元之間動態調整，逢高適度調節獲利，逢低則進場布局，操作上兼具靈活性與收益考量，並不會受到流動性覆蓋比率的排擠。
在換匯交易收益表現上，廖文偉說明，今年前10月第一金換匯交易收益已達約90億元，今年全年可望挑戰105億元水準。展望明年，由於台美差預期仍將持續擴大，換匯交易收益動能看俏，預估明年全年收益區間將進一步攀升至125億元至127億元。
而在整體金控獲利動能方面，由於今年資本市場熱絡墊高基期，今年前9月每股盈餘年增率高達19.6%，明年整體獲利成長目標將以貼近國內經濟成長率的6%左右為合理基準。
此外，為強化雙引擎獲利結構，第一金積極拉升非銀行子公司的獲利貢獻。今年截至9月底，第一金證券獲利已達20億元，第一金人壽獲利也來到約6.5億元，帶動非銀行子公司整體獲利佔比提升至13%至14%區間。
展望明年，金控內部對證券與人壽設定雙位數的高成長目標，期盼明年非銀行子公司獲利佔比能正式突破15%，並審慎評估透過增資或拓展外部通路擴大營運規模。
paras_en: First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) held an online analyst briefing today (27th), hosted by Deputy General Manager Zhuang Shujian and Deputy General Manager Zhu Furong of Bank of Taiwan. They gave clear guidance on dividend policy, emphasizing that cash dividends will be the primary focus going forward, with a target cash payout ratio of over 60%. Whether stock dividends will be issued remains under discussion. In light of recent volatility in Taiwan stocks, Deputy General Manager Liao Wen‑wei of Bank of Taiwan sees a prime buying opportunity on dips, forecasting next‑year foreign‑exchange transaction earnings to expand to about NT$12.7 billion, while aiming for non‑bank subsidiaries such as securities and life insurance to exceed a 15% profit contribution share.

Regarding dividend plans, Zhuang Shujian said the company has always valued long‑term returns to shareholders and will maintain cash dividends as the core policy, setting a cash payout ratio of at least 60% as a principle. The actual payout level will consider the overall subsidiaries’ earnings contributions, future business expansion needs, and capital adequacy planning. As for stock dividends next year, each subsidiary and the holding company are still discussing annual budgets and capital plans, with no decision yet, and the company will strive to return value to shareholders in the most beneficial way.

On financial operations and investment positioning, Liao Wen‑wei noted that Taiwan’s economy is projected to grow 11%‑12% this year and maintain a solid 5.5%‑6% growth next year, buoyed by AI and semiconductor trends. The recent market correction has highlighted the investment value of many quality stocks, creating a good opportunity to buy on lows.

Liao added that the bank’s equity holdings currently range dynamically between NT$200 billion and NT$300 billion. The strategy is to modestly trim positions on rallies and add on dips, balancing flexibility with return considerations, and it will not be constrained by liquidity coverage ratio pressures.

Regarding foreign‑exchange transaction earnings, Liao explained that for the first ten months of this year First Financial’s FX trading profit has reached about NT$9 billion, and the full‑year target is around NT$10.5 billion. Looking ahead, with the Taiwan‑U.S. rate differential expected to widen further, the momentum is strong and the full‑year FY2025 earnings are projected to climb to a range of NT$12.5 billion‑NT$12.7 billion.

On overall holding‑company profit momentum, a strong capital‑market environment lifted the base this year, delivering a year‑over‑year EPS growth of 19.6% for the first nine months. The profit‑growth target for next year is set around 6%, roughly in line with domestic economic growth.

To strengthen its dual‑engine profit structure, First Financial is actively boosting contributions from non‑bank subsidiaries. As of the end of September, First Financial Securities posted NT$2 billion in profit and First Financial Life reported about NT$650 million, raising the overall non‑bank profit share to between 13% and 14%.

Looking ahead to next year, the holding company has set double‑digit growth targets for its securities and life‑insurance arms, hoping the non‑bank profit share will officially surpass 15%. It will also carefully evaluate capital increases or expanding external distribution channels to enlarge its operating scale.

items.title: 中鋼10月營業利益月增28%、稅前盈餘6.11億元 多國鋼廠盤價穩中有升
items.title_en: China Steel October Operating Profit Up 28% MoM, Pre‑Tax Earnings NT$6.11 Billion; Steel Mill Prices Stable with Gains in Several Countries
paras: 中鋼(2002-TW)今(27)日公告10月自結損益，受惠鋼價上漲帶動，單月營業利益6.01億元，月增28%、稅前盈餘6.11億元，月增4.8%；前10月營業利益51.48億元、稅前盈餘43.01億元，單月及累計均較去年同期轉盈。
鋼鐵市況方面，中鋼表示，煉鋼成本仍處相對高位，美國現貨供給趨緊，熱軋流通行情續漲創近年新高；歐盟受惠於貿易措施及CBAM政策限制進口，當地熱軋流通行情穩步上升；亞洲地區需求釋出仍待觀察，然整體粗鋼產量持續收縮，加以成本支撐，多國鋼廠盤價呈穩中有升態勢。
總經方面，全球經濟活動維持穩定擴張，IMF預估今年全球經濟成長率3.1%，明年升至3.4%。人工智慧發展挹注台灣出口與投資成長動能，台經院上修今年台灣經濟成長率至12.34%，明年預測穩健成長6.45%。
中鋼10月營收320.4億元，創29個月新高，月增3.35%、年增31%；累計前10月營收2887.71億元，年增8.4%。中鋼表示，10月鋼鐵業銷售數量及單位毛利較上月增加，推升營業利益表現，業外則因礦業投資獲配股利減少。
paras_en: China Steel (2002‑TW) announced its October interim results on the 27th. Benefiting from higher steel prices, operating profit for the month reached NT$6.01 billion, up 28% month‑on‑month, and pre‑tax earnings were NT$6.11 billion, up 4.8%. For the first ten months, operating profit totaled NT$51.48 billion and pre‑tax earnings NT$43.01 billion, both turning to profit compared with the same period last year.

Regarding steel market conditions, China Steel said that steel‑making costs remain relatively high, U.S. spot supply is tightening, and hot‑rolled market prices continue to rise to near‑record highs. In the EU, trade measures and the CBAM policy limiting imports have helped local hot‑rolled prices climb steadily. Demand in Asia is still uncertain, but overall crude steel production keeps contracting, and with cost support, steel mill prices in many countries show a stable‑plus‑rise trend.

On the macro side, global economic activity remains in stable expansion, with the IMF projecting a 3.1% world‑GDP growth this year and 3.4% next year. Advances in artificial intelligence are boosting Taiwan’s export and investment momentum, prompting the Taiwan Economic Research Institute to raise Taiwan’s 2024 growth forecast to 2.34% and project a solid 6.45% growth for next year.

China Steel’s October revenue hit NT$32.04 billion, a 29‑month high, up 3.35% month‑on‑month and 31% year‑on‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first ten months reached NT$288.771 billion, an 8.4% increase year‑on‑year. The company said that higher sales volume and unit gross margin in October lifted operating profit, while non‑operating income fell due to reduced dividend allocations from mining investments.

items.title: 免驚美國反AI聲浪？主計上修今明年台灣GDP 創80年代來新高峰
items.title_en: No Need to Fear U.S. Anti‑AI Sentiment? Taiwan’s Statistics Agency Raises 2023‑2024 GDP to Highest Level Since the 1980s
paras: 主計總處今(27)日發布台灣經濟成長率(GDP)最新預測值，因今年第4季GDP衝上10.42%，上修5.05個百分點，推升全年GDP達13.28%，上修2.23個百分點，將是48年來新高(民國67年以來)，而明年GDP仍可達6.51%，也上修0.47個百分點。
主計總處強調，雖美國擴大AI出口管制，且反對資料中心建置的美國民間聲浪可能促使地方政府加強監管，但 AI發展態勢已確立。
因此，整體而言，預測今年台灣GDP規模1兆869億美元，每人GDP 4萬6767美元， 消費者物價指數(CPI)上漲2.07%，而明年每人GDP更將達5萬779美元。

paras_en: The Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) released today (27th) its latest GDP growth forecasts, raising the Q4 2023 GDP to 10.42% and revising it up by 5.05 percentage points, which lifts the full‑year 2023 GDP to 13.28% – an increase of 2.23 points and the highest in 48 years (since 1978). The agency also raised the 2024 GDP forecast to 6.51%, up 0.47 points.

The agency stressed that although the United States is expanding AI export controls and domestic opposition to data‑center construction could prompt local governments to tighten regulation, the overall trajectory of AI development is already set.

Overall, Taiwan’s 2023 GDP is projected at US$1.0869 trillion, with per‑capita GDP of US$46,767, and a consumer price index (CPI) rise of 2.07%. In 2024, per‑capita GDP is expected to reach US$57,790.

The DGBAS explained that as proxy‑AI and inference applications deepen, computing‑power demand keeps growing. Major global cloud service providers are actively expanding AI infrastructure, and Taiwan’s AI supply chain enjoys strong competitive advantages. Shortages of key components such as memory chips and substrates are pushing up prices, boosting exports of related electronic and ICT products. At the same time, traditional‑industry goods exports are warming, with Q4 merchandise exports forecast at US$277.1 billion, a 47.88% year‑over‑year increase – the highest in nearly 50 years.
Merchandise imports, driven by export‑linked and investment‑related demand, are projected at US$200.9 billion for Q4, up 53.91% year‑over‑year.
Including the first three quarters, total exports and imports for the year are expected to grow 23.96% and 21.41% respectively, revisions of +2.68 and +0.26 percentage points.

Looking ahead to next year, the agency noted that while U.S. AI export controls and public resistance to data‑center projects may lead local authorities to tighten oversight – affecting investment costs and timelines – the AI development trend remains firm. Cloud providers, compute suppliers and multiple governments continue to pour money into AI, keeping demand for related infrastructure and equipment higher than supply. Taiwanese firms are expanding capacity and advancing processes, and traditional sectors such as electrical, machinery and plastics are benefiting from AI‑derived opportunities, all supporting continued export momentum.

The DGBAS forecasts 2024 merchandise exports at US$1.1135 trillion and imports at US$827.6 billion, representing year‑over‑year growth of 18.63% and 17.93% respectively on a high base. items.title: 不只是車廠 特斯拉獲利能力優於同業 估值指標遠甩通用與法拉利
items.title_en: Not Just a Car Maker: Tesla’s Profitability Beats Peers and Valuation Metrics Far Outpace General Motors and Ferrari
paras: 根據媒體 Benzinga 報導，特斯拉(TSLA-US)在由汽車製造商、豪華車廠商及休閒車生產商組成的汽車產業中營運。儘管同業競爭激烈，特斯拉在多項關鍵估值指標上均居整體產業群組之冠，顯示出資本市場給予其極高的溢價與期待。
Benzinga 提出的估值數據顯示，按當前股價計算，特斯拉的本益比(P/E)高達 422.7 倍，遠高於整體汽車產業中位數的 26.3 倍，明顯超越豪華跑車品牌法拉利(Ferrari)的 37.9 倍。
在股價淨值比(P/B)方面，特斯拉達到 17.0 倍，高於產業中位數的 1.2 倍以及法拉利的 16.2 倍。此外，特斯拉的股價營收比(P/S)來到 13.1 倍，同樣遠高於產業中位數的 0.4 倍與法拉利的 8.5 倍。
這些指標凸顯，特斯拉在資本市場上的估值結構，遠高於傳統車廠如通用汽車(GM-US)及同業基準。
在獲利能力方面，Benzinga 報導指出，特斯拉在過去 12 個月中展現出高於同業平均的毛利率與營業利益率。其毛利率達到 19.3%，優於產業中位數的 9.2%；營業利益率為 3.5%，高於產業中位數的 2.1%；淨利率則達到 3.1%，亦領先產業中位數的 1.5%。
綜合來看，特斯拉雖然在毛利率與營業利益率等營運指標上優於傳統汽車產業平均，但其本益比與股價淨值比等估值指標甚至超越了法拉利等頂級豪華車品牌。
paras_en: According to media outlet Benzinga, Tesla (TSLA-US) operates within the automotive industry, which includes automobile manufacturers, luxury car makers, and recreational vehicle producers. Despite intense competition, Tesla tops the overall industry group on several key valuation metrics, indicating that the capital markets assign it a very high premium and expectations.

Benzinga’s valuation data shows that, based on the current share price, Tesla’s price‑earnings ratio (P/E) is a staggering 422.7 times, far above the industry median of 26.3 times and clearly surpassing luxury sports‑car brand Ferrari’s 37.9 times.

On a price‑to‑book basis (P/B), Tesla reaches 17.0 times, higher than the industry median of 1.2 times and also above Ferrari’s 16.2 times. In addition, Tesla’s price‑to‑sales ratio (P/S) stands at 13.1 times, again far exceeding the industry median of 0.4 times and Ferrari’s 8.5 times.
These figures highlight that Tesla’s valuation structure in the capital markets is much higher than that of traditional automakers such as General Motors (GM-US) and other industry benchmarks.

Regarding profitability, Benzinga reports that over the past 12 months Tesla has posted gross margin and operating margin levels above the industry average. Its gross margin is 19.3%, better than the industry median of 9.2%; operating margin is 3.5%, above the median of 2.1%; and net margin is 3.1%, also leading the industry median of 1.5%.

Overall, while Tesla outperforms the average traditional automotive industry on operating metrics such as gross and operating margins, its valuation multiples like P/E and P/B even exceed those of top‑tier luxury brands such as Ferrari.

items.title: 特斯拉人形機器人布局有新動作？擬收購德國工具機廠EMAG資產
items.title_en: Tesla Humanoid Robot Plans Take a New Turn? Plans to Acquire German Machine‑Tool Firm EMAG’s Assets
paras: 2026年11月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)擬收購德國工具機廠EMAG集團資產。德國聯邦卡特爾局27日公布的案件資料顯示，特斯拉已於23日申報，案件列為資產收購，涉及金屬精密製造、電化學及雷射加工等領域。EMAG除了供應電動車零件的加工設備，也已推出人形機器人關節零件的加工方案。
這筆交易之所以值得從Optimus的量產進度來看，是因為馬斯克在10月21日法說會上點出的難題，不是做不出一台機器人，而是要讓零件供應、產品設計、工廠生產和AI訓練同時跟上。以手部為例，設計尚未定型，特斯拉已先製造一批機器人用於訓練，同時繼續調整設計及產線。公司第三季資料顯示，加州佛利蒙廠已開始生產，但仍在初期爬坡；德州廠則仍在建置。
EMAG位於人形機器人供應鏈的上游，主要提供製造關節零件所需的精密工具機與整合產線，並非供應整套關節模組。人形機器人的關節要做旋轉和直線動作，可能用到諧波減速器、行星齒輪與行星滾柱螺桿。各類零件的形狀和精度要求不同，不能靠同一道工序完成。EMAG把車削、齒輪加工、研磨及量測等工序整合在產線上，減少零件在機台間反覆裝夾所造成的誤差，讓加工精度在批量生產時更容易維持一致。
特斯拉過去也曾透過收購取得德國的製造設備能力。2017年，特斯拉以1.095億美元現金收購自動化設備商Grohmann Engineering；2025年，旗下Tesla Automation接手設備廠Manz在羅伊特林根的部分資產與逾300名員工。此次EMAG案尚未公布交易金額、涵蓋的業務，也未確認相關設備是否用於Optimus。

paras_en: November 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Tesla (TSLA‑US) is planning to acquire the assets of German machine‑tool maker EMAG Group. According to case information released by the German Federal Cartel Office on the 27th, Tesla filed the application on the 23rd, categorising the deal as an asset purchase that involves metal precision manufacturing, electro‑chemical and laser processing. In addition to supplying equipment for electric‑vehicle parts, EMAG has also launched machining solutions for humanoid‑robot joint components.

The transaction is noteworthy for the mass‑production timeline of Optimus because the challenge Elon Musk highlighted at the October 21 earnings call was not building a robot, but synchronising parts supply, product design, factory production and AI training. For example, the hand design is still unsettled; Tesla has already built a batch of robots for training while continuing to tweak the design and the production line. The company’s Q3 data show that the Fremont, California plant has started production but is still in the early ramp‑up phase, while the Texas plant is still being built.

EMAG sits upstream in the humanoid‑robot supply chain, primarily providing the precision machine tools and integrated production lines needed to manufacture joint parts, rather than supplying complete joint modules. Robot joints require both rotational and linear motion and may use harmonic drives, planetary gears and planetary ball‑screw actuators. Different parts have varying shape and tolerance requirements that cannot be met in a single machining step. EMAG integrates turning, gear cutting, grinding and measurement processes on a single line, reducing repeated clamping errors between machines and making it easier to maintain consistent precision in volume production.

Tesla has previously acquired German manufacturing‑equipment capabilities. In 2017, it bought automation equipment maker Grohmann Engineering for $109.5 million in cash; in 2025, its Tesla Automation unit took over parts of equipment maker Manz’s Lohr‑Lingen assets and more than 300 employees. The EMAG deal has not disclosed the transaction amount, the scope of the business, nor whether the equipment will be used for Optimus.

items.title: 輝達AI帝國非單打獨鬥！美股新ETF瞄準非美半導體供應鏈

paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳的回歸重新點燃了整個人工智慧(AI)產業的樂觀情緒。然而，對於希望把握半導體產業下一波繁榮契機的投資人而言，或許需要將目光投向美國以外的晶片製造商。

根據報導內容，ISMH追蹤VettaFi國際半導體指數，涵蓋晶片設計、智慧財產權、製造裝置、晶圓代工、記憶體以及封裝測試等領域的公司，為投資人提供對 25 家在美國境外上市的半導體及相關企業的投資管道與曝險。

與VanEck半導體ETF(SMH-US)和iShares半導體ETF(SOXX-US)等熱門的美國聚焦型半導體ETF不同，ISMH專門投資非美國公司。
這一區別至關重要，因為人工智慧基礎設施支出正推動晶片生產多個環節的需求，從先進製造裝置到高頻寬記憶體。
報導總結指出，全球 AI 晶片狂潮的背後，高度仰賴跨國半導體產業鏈的緊密協同。投資人在佈局 AI 浪潮時，除了關注美國本土晶片大廠外，也可留意這些位於美國之外的國際半導體領頭羊。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang's return has reignited optimism across the entire artificial intelligence (AI) industry. However, investors looking to capture the next wave of prosperity in the semiconductor sector may need to turn their attention to chipmakers outside the United States.

According to Benzinga, NVIDIA's massive AI empire is not sustained by NVIDIA alone; overseas supply‑chain companies also play a crucial role. The newly launched xETFs International Semiconductor Index ETF (ISMH-US) validates this investment logic.

The report says ISMH tracks the VettaFi International Semiconductor Index, covering companies involved in chip design, intellectual property, manufacturing equipment, wafer foundry, memory, and packaging/testing, providing investors exposure to 25 semiconductor and related firms listed outside the United States.
Its core holdings include several global semiconductor giants such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSM-US) (2330-TW), Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix (SKHY-US), and ASML (ASML-US).
Unlike popular US‑focused semiconductor ETFs like VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH-US) and iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX-US), ISMH invests exclusively in non‑US companies.
This distinction is critical because AI infrastructure spending is driving demand across multiple stages of chip production, from advanced manufacturing equipment to high‑bandwidth memory.

The report concludes that the global AI chip frenzy relies heavily on tight coordination across the multinational semiconductor supply chain. When positioning for the AI wave, investors should not only watch domestic US chip giants but also consider these international semiconductor leaders outside the United States.

items.title_en: TSMC Plans Second Advanced Wafer Fab in the U.S.! BofA Reaffirms Buy, Target TWD 3,260, Implied Upside Over 50%
paras: 美國銀行(BAC-US)分析師Haas Liu週五(27日)出具最新研究報告，維持台積電(2330-TW)股票「買進」評等，目標價3260新台幣，係以20倍2027年預期本益比估算而得，目前股價對應2027/2028年本益比僅約13.5倍/10.7倍，估值具防禦空間。
報告聚焦台積電向德州JETI提交的申請：這家全球晶圓代工龍頭打算投資226億美元於布拉索斯縣新建晶圓園區，亞利桑那仍列備選，稅收減免為關鍵變因。項目鎖定2奈米及以下製程，供AI、HPC與先進行動晶片，規劃2028年動工、2031年投產，2032年前形成每月2萬至2.5萬片先進產能；資金配置62%攻設備、38%建廠房，設備採購集中2030-2032年。
Liu指出，市場雖憂2028年AI資本開支放緩，但台積電AI營收高增、現金流改善支撐溢價；預估2028年自由現金流每股136.16新台幣，自由現金流收益率達6.33%。
在美佈局上，亞利桑那廠已是華府「先進晶片本土製造」戰略核心，台積電累計在美承諾投資2650億美元，該廠現已量產輝達Blackwell，並代工超微、蘋果訂單。
在歐洲，台積電與英飛凌、博世、恩智浦合資的歐積電(ESMC)的德國德勒斯登廠主體結構已於今年9月完工，2027年底投產，鎖定歐洲車用與工業晶片。
不過，報告也提醒風險變數，包括消費電子需求弱於預期、先進製程進度延宕、關稅與在地對手競爭加劇以及AI資本支出回落壓縮先進製程訂單。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) analyst Haas Liu issued a new research report on Friday (the 27th), maintaining a “Buy” rating on TSMC (2330‑TW) stock with a target price of TWD 3,260. The target is derived from a 20‑times 2027 forward P/E estimate; the current share price reflects only about a 13.5‑times/10.7‑times P/E for 2027/2028, indicating defensive valuation space.

The report focuses on TSMC’s application to Texas’ JETI: the global wafer‑foundry leader plans to invest $22.6 billion to build a new wafer campus in Brazos County, with Arizona still a backup option and tax incentives a key factor. The project targets 2‑nm and below processes for AI, HPC and advanced mobile chips, slated to break ground in 2028 and start production in 2031, reaching 20,000‑25,000 advanced wafers per month before 2032. Capital allocation is 62% for equipment and 38% for fab construction, with equipment purchases concentrated in 2030‑2032.

Liu notes that while the market worries about a slowdown in AI cap‑ex in 2028, TSMC’s strong AI revenue growth and improving cash flow support a premium. He estimates 2028 free cash flow at TWD 136.16 per share, yielding a free‑cash‑flow return of 6.33%.

Regarding U.S. deployment, the Arizona plant is already a core element of Washington’s “domestic advanced‑chip manufacturing” strategy. TSMC has pledged a cumulative $265 billion investment in the United States; the Arizona fab now mass‑produces Nvidia’s Blackwell chips and also manufactures for AMD and Apple orders.

In Europe, the main structure of the joint venture Euro‑SMC (ESMC) with Infineon, Bosch and NXP – the Dresden plant in Germany – was completed in September this year, with production slated for the end of 2027, targeting automotive and industrial chips for the European market.

The report also flags risk variables, including consumer‑electronics demand weaker than expected, delays in advanced‑process rollouts, higher tariffs and intensified competition from local rivals, and a pull‑back in AI cap‑ex that could compress orders for advanced processes.

items.title: 不是賣鏟人是地基！ASML執行長：AI資料中心取決於我司擴產速度　用「代差槓桿」綁住陸半導體
items.title_en: Not a Shovel Seller but a Foundation! ASML CEO: AI Data Center Growth Depends on Our Expansion Speed, Using a "Generation Gap Leverage" to Bind Mainland Semiconductor
paras: 全球唯一極紫外(EUV)光刻機製造商艾司摩爾(ASML-US) ，正站在AI算力擴張與地緣科技戰的最前線，執行長Christophe Fouquet周三(25日)做客《Future Proof》播客節目時首度系統性拆解「EUV擴產瓶頸、記憶體漲價週期、對中出口管制哲學」三大命題，並拋出最新判斷稱「ASML不是AI賣鏟人，而是AI基礎設施的地基」。
Fouquet透露，2024、2025年EUV需求尚稱平靜，去年底客戶訂單突然爆發，今年EUV產量已較去年提升50%，今年預計交付約65台(去年44台)，2027年目標再增28%–30%，朝向80台以上推進，部分客戶甚至已談到2029–2030年設備意向。
但單台EUV體積如校車、涉及超過2000家供應商，真正卡關的不是人力與廠房——裝機人員培訓僅需3至6個月，廠房也早有規劃——而是光學系統從玻璃原料到可裝機「要數年交付週期」，其中蔡司反射鏡、Cymer光源等獨占環節，決定產能天花板。
Fouquet說，「客戶需求能看到2030年，但我們交不出那麼快」，並指單一供應源本身就是產業風險，ASML正優化組裝空間、壓縮驗證步驟、導入非關鍵零件二供，但先進光學仍難繞開長週期。
更尖銳的矛盾在記憶體。Fouquet指出，記憶體晶片價格已漲至原水準5至10倍，每1GW AI資料中心資本開支高達500億至600億美元，超大规模雲端服務廠尚可轉嫁成本，但PC、手機、電動車被直接壓制。
Fouquet援引傑文斯悖論說，「價格降下來的唯一解法是擴產，而多數新增產能2028年才到位」，價格回跌後被壓抑需求會再釋放，供需再平衡還要數年，這代表消費電子與車用晶片成本壓力，短期難解。
地緣部分最引起華府側目。Fouquet則重申道：「EUV從未交付中國，每台機器在哪我們都清楚，運一台要數架747，不可能偷運，但反對把DUV也一刀切禁死。」
Fouquet還提出「代差策略」說：「現售中國DUV是13年前機型，ASML其後已迭代八代。保住最先進技術，同時讓對方繼續依賴你的生態，才是戰略工具；逼到牆角，對方就會加倍甚至三倍下注自研。」
他並判斷，中國在EUV實用化上仍落後10至15年；沒EUV，7奈米靠DUV多重曝光良率慘烈，堆疊封裝換算力則犧牲功耗與效率。「說法很多、數據很少，看到量產數據前我們不擔心。」
Fouquet還警告，若華府進一步禁掉在中國設備維護，「原廠退出後，第三方照樣讓機台轉起來，我們只會失去控制權」，這也呼應他的商業邏輯。ASML近30年在中國市佔率曾接近100%，中國Q3仍佔其系統銷售23%，硬切斷等同自毀槓桿。
技術路線上，High-NA數值孔徑由0.33升至0.55，邏輯與記憶體電晶體密度約3倍躍進，支撐1.0邏輯節點與下世代記憶體。他也笑稱摩爾定律未死，「只是被AI打了興奮劑」。
至於xLight自由電子雷射、氦原子光刻等顛覆路線，Fouquet給出了工程師式的門檻：新光源成本須比現行低30%–40%、且能跑滿全球晶圓廠可用率，實驗室跑通不算數。
Fouquet提醒，EUV是數十年大學基礎研究與產業工程化的果實。企業不做純基礎研究，但須資助大學與imec，「砍學術經費，就是砍二、三十年後的下一個突破」。
眼下，AI資料中心能蓋多快，取決ASML地基擴產速度，而中國會繼續依賴、還是被迫另起爐灶，取決華府如何拿捏那把「代差之尺」。這把尺若失準，西方失去的不只是訂單，而是半導體霸權的時間窗口。
paras_en: ASML, the world’s only extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machine maker, is at the forefront of AI compute expansion and the geopolitics of technology. CEO Christophe Fouquet, speaking on the “Future Proof” podcast on Wednesday (the 25th), systematically broke down three major topics – EUV capacity bottlenecks, memory price‑rise cycles, and the philosophy behind export controls to China – and asserted that “ASML is not a shovel‑seller for AI, but the foundation of AI infrastructure.”

Fouquet disclosed that EUV demand in 2024 and 2025 remains relatively calm, but a sudden surge in customer orders at the end of last year has already lifted this year’s EUV output by about 50% versus last year. The company expects to ship roughly 65 machines this year (up from 44 last year) and aims for a further 28%‑30% increase by 2027, pushing the total above 80 units, with some customers already discussing equipment intentions for 2029‑2030.

A single EUV machine is as large as a school bus and involves more than 2,000 suppliers. The real bottleneck is not labor or factory space – installation staff can be trained in three to six months and facilities have already been planned – but the optical system, which from raw glass to a installable unit takes years to deliver. Key exclusive components such as Zeiss reflective mirrors and Cymer light sources set the ceiling on capacity.

Fouquet said, “Customers can see demand out to 2030, but we cannot deliver that fast,” and noted that reliance on a single source is itself an industry risk. ASML is optimizing assembly space, compressing verification steps, and introducing secondary suppliers for non‑critical parts, yet advanced optics remain hard to bypass because of their long lead times.

The sharper contradiction lies in memory. Fouquet pointed out that memory chip prices have risen to five‑ to ten‑fold their original levels, and each 1 GW AI data center now requires $50‑$60 billion in capital expenditure. Large‑scale cloud providers can pass those costs on, but PCs, smartphones and electric vehicles feel the pressure directly.

Citing the Jevons paradox, Fouquet said, “The only way to bring prices down is to expand capacity, and most of the new capacity won’t be online until 2028.” After prices fall, suppressed demand will be released, but re‑balancing supply and demand will take years, meaning cost pressure on consumer electronics and automotive chips remains a short‑term challenge.

The geopolitical angle drew the most attention in Washington. Fouquet reiterated, “We have never delivered an EUV machine to China; we know exactly where each machine is, and shipping one requires several 747s – smuggling is impossible. However, we oppose a blanket ban on DUV as well.”

He also introduced a “generation‑gap strategy,” stating, “The DUV machines we currently sell to China are models from 13 years ago; ASML has since iterated eight generations. Keeping the most advanced technology to ourselves while letting the other side remain dependent on our ecosystem is a strategic tool; corner them and they will double or even triple‑down on their own R&D.”

He judged that China is still 10‑15 years behind in practical EUV use; without EUV, 7‑nm nodes rely on DUV multi‑patterning with terrible yields, and stacking and packaging for compute power sacrifices power efficiency. “There are many claims but little data; we won’t worry until we see production numbers.”

Fouquet warned that if Washington further bans equipment maintenance in China, “once the OEM pulls out, third‑party services can still keep the machines running, and we will only lose control.” This echoes his business logic: ASML’s market share in China was close to 100 % for nearly three decades, and China still accounted for 23 % of its system sales in Q3; a hard cut‑off would be self‑destructive leverage.

On the technical front, the High‑NA numerical aperture is rising from 0.33 to 0.55, delivering roughly a three‑fold jump in logic and memory transistor density and supporting the 1.0 nm logic node and next‑generation memory. He joked that Moore’s Law isn’t dead – it’s just been given a caffeine boost by AI.

Regarding disruptive routes such as xLight free‑electron lasers and helium‑atom lithography, Fouquet gave an engineer’s threshold: the new light source must cost 30‑40 % less than current ones and be able to run at full utilization across global fabs; lab‑scale success alone doesn’t count.

Fouquet reminded that EUV is the fruit of decades of university basic research and industrial engineering. Companies may not do pure basic research, but they must fund universities and institutes like imec; “cutting academic funding is cutting the next breakthrough that will arrive in twenty‑ or thirty‑years.”

Today, how quickly AI data centers can be built depends on ASML’s foundation‑building speed, and whether China continues to rely on us or is forced to start its own path depends on how Washington handles the “generation‑gap ruler.” If that ruler is mis‑measured, the West loses not only orders but the time window for semiconductor dominance.

items.title: 從矽谷到深圳：美國新創企業為效率移轉開發重心 但也面臨風險
items.title_en: From Silicon Valley to Shenzhen: U.S. Startups Shift Development Focus for Efficiency but Face Risks
paras: 根據美國媒體 NBC 報導，部分美國硬體科技新創公司正逐漸將開發重心從矽谷轉向中國深圳。這股趨勢主要源於當地高度集中的硬體供應鏈、快速的原型打樣效率，以及成熟的製造合作生態系統。
對於前沿硬體開發團隊而言，零組件取得與測試效率是核心考量。舊金山智慧穿戴裝置新創 Mentra 的創始工程師 Nicolo Micheletti 表示，深圳聚集了大量的原始設計製造商(ODM)與零組件供應商，幾乎開發產品所需的一切都在短途計程車車程內。
開發腦機介面裝置的新創公司 Voyage 共同創辦人 Hiteyjit Gujral 指出，在新興技術領域「時間就是金錢」，跨國等待零組件會嚴重拖慢迭代步調。創業孵化器 Troublemaker 經營者 Henk Werner 補充，當地的協作效率極高，設計師於凌晨發送圖紙，清晨就有機會取得實體原型。
除研發速度外，成本也是關鍵誘因。任職於神經科技新創 Domayn 的工程師 Heather Nelson 認為，雖然在美國創業並非不可能，但已難以在本土維持相同的開發速度與低成本。
投資中國科技企業的避險基金 Snow Bull Capital 執行長 Taylor Ogan 則稱深圳為「本世紀的機遇之地」；他表示親臨當地能直接檢視供應鏈的各個製造環節，而矽谷雖保有許多創新概念，但最終產品多半在深圳製造完成。
儘管深圳具備製造優勢，新創團隊仍面臨挑戰。Heather Nelson 與相關分析提到，矽谷在風險資本與頂尖人才上仍具優勢，且外籍創業者需克服語言溝通門檻。此外，報導引述美國國務院報告警示，美中地緣政治緊張、出口管制擴大，以及智慧財產權保護與監管環境的不確定性，皆為跨境營運帶來潛在風險。
paras_en: According to U.S. media outlet NBC, some American hardware‑tech startups are gradually shifting their development focus from Silicon Valley to Shenzhen, China. The trend is driven by the region’s highly concentrated hardware supply chain, fast prototyping turnaround, and a mature manufacturing partnership ecosystem.

For cutting‑edge hardware development teams, component acquisition and testing efficiency are core considerations. Nicolo Micheletti, founding engineer of San Francisco smart‑wearable startup Mentra, said Shenzhen gathers a large number of original design manufacturers (ODMs) and component suppliers, with almost everything needed to develop a product within a short taxi ride.

Voyage, a startup developing brain‑computer‑interface devices, co‑founder Hiteyjit Gujral noted that in emerging‑technology fields “time is money,” and waiting across borders for components can severely slow iteration. Troublemaker incubator operator Henk Werner added that local collaboration is extremely efficient—designers can send drawings late at night and have a physical prototype available by morning.

Beyond R&D speed, cost is also a key incentive. Heather Nelson, an engineer at neuro‑tech startup Domayn, believes that while starting a company in the United States is not impossible, it is increasingly difficult to maintain the same development pace and low costs domestically.

Taylor Ogan, CEO of Snow Bull Capital – a hedge fund that hedges by investing in Chinese tech firms – called Shenzhen “the opportunity hub of this century.” He said being on the ground allows direct inspection of every manufacturing step in the supply chain, whereas Silicon Valley may generate many innovative concepts but most final products are manufactured in Shenzhen.

Even with Shenzhen’s manufacturing advantages, startup teams still face challenges. Nelson and other analysts point out that Silicon Valley retains advantages in venture capital and top talent, and foreign founders must overcome language barriers. Moreover, a U.S. State Department report warns that heightened U.S.–China geopolitical tension, expanding export controls, and uncertainties around intellectual‑property protection and regulatory environments pose potential risks for cross‑border operations.

items.title: 全球黃金「大搬風」！法國率先結束近一世紀託管 全球3.6萬噸儲備版圖重劃
items.title_en: Global Gold “Great Migration”: France Leads the End of Nearly a Century of Overseas Custody, Redrawing the Map of 36,000‑ton Reserves
paras: 最新數據顯示，一場靜默的「黃金大遷徙」正重塑全球儲備版圖。從新德里、法蘭克福到華沙、阿姆斯特丹，各國央行持續將黃金從紐約、倫敦傳統託管中心撤回本國或更可控司法區。在制裁風險、貿易衝突與對西方金融體系信任下滑驅動下，這波「黃金回家」明顯加速，各國欲重新掌握危機時刻的資產控制權。
世界黃金協會(WGC)最新數據顯示，全球主要央行黃金(XAUUSDOZ)儲備逾3.6萬噸，美國8133噸居首，德、義、法、中、俄緊隨，但真正變化在「存放地」：法國已處置在美129噸黃金，透過「在紐約賣、歐洲買」完成本土歸庫，結束近一世紀海外託管；印度3年間海外佔比從55%降至22%，本土持金達680噸；荷蘭把86噸從北美轉倫敦，波蘭運回百噸至華沙，德國、奧地利、土耳其亦持續降低對美英依賴。
根據WGC今年對76家央行的調查，存放英倫銀行比例由64%降至57%，紐約聯準銀行由17%降至14%，過去一年19%央行擴大本土存金或多元化託管，較前期7%翻倍。45%央行正擴建本國金庫。
轉向主因是主權安全。2022年俄羅斯央行約3千億美元資產遭凍結，讓「海外金庫再安全也不等於拿得到」成為共識。各國寧捨流動性，換物理控制權與金融自主。
代價與漣漪同步擴散：紐倫託管收益與定價影響力流失，美元、英鎊信用承壓，全球黃金流動性下降，全球央行連16年淨購入黃金，今年Q2買進289噸、年增62%。
分析人士指出，這不是短期避險，而是儲備體系「效率優先」轉向「安全優先」的結構重排；黃金回流本國或中立金庫，將成去美元化與金融多極化的最硬錨點。
paras_en: The latest data show a silent “gold migration” reshaping the global reserve map. From New Delhi and Frankfurt to Warsaw and Amsterdam, central banks are steadily pulling gold out of the traditional custodial hubs of New York and London and returning it to their own countries or more controllable jurisdictions. Driven by sanction risks, trade conflicts and waning trust in the Western financial system, this wave of “gold homecoming” is clearly accelerating as nations seek to regain control over assets in times of crisis.

World Gold Council (WGC) data indicate that the world’s major central‑bank gold holdings (XAUUSDOZ) exceed 36,000 tonnes, with the United States holding the largest share at 8,133 tonnes, followed by Germany, Italy, France, China and Russia. The real shift is in the “location” of those holdings: France has disposed of 129 tonnes stored in the United States, completing a “sell in New York, buy in Europe” operation that brings the gold back to domestic vaults and ends almost a century of overseas custody; India’s overseas share fell from 55 % to 22 % over three years, leaving 680 tonnes at home; the Netherlands moved 86 tonnes from North America to London, Poland shipped a hundred tonnes back to Warsaw, and Germany, Austria and Turkey are also steadily reducing reliance on the U.S. and U.K. custodians.

According to the WGC’s survey of 76 central banks this year, the share of gold stored with British banks dropped from 64 % to 57 %, while the share held with the New York Federal Reserve fell from 17 % to 14 %. In the past year, 19 % of central banks expanded domestic holdings or diversified custodial locations, double the 7 % rate of the previous period. Meanwhile, 45 % of central banks are expanding their own national vaults.

The main driver is sovereign security. In 2022 the Russian central bank saw roughly $300 billion of assets frozen, cementing the consensus that “even the safest overseas vault is useless if you can’t access it.” Countries are therefore willing to sacrifice liquidity in exchange for physical control and financial autonomy.

The costs and ripple effects are spreading together: New York custodial fees and pricing influence are eroding, putting pressure on the credibility of the dollar and the pound, while global gold liquidity is declining. Central banks have been net buyers of gold for 16 consecutive years; in Q2 this year they purchased 289 tonnes, up 62 % year‑on‑year.

Analysts say this is not a short‑term hedge but a structural re‑ordering of reserve systems from “efficiency‑first” to “security‑first.” The repatriation of gold to domestic or neutral vaults will become the hardest anchor of de‑dollarisation and the multipolarisation of finance.

items.title: 不只是車廠 特斯拉獲利能力優於同業 估值指標遠甩通用與法拉利
items.title_en: Not Just a Car Maker: Tesla’s Profitability Beats Peers and Valuation Metrics Far Outpace General Motors and Ferrari
paras: 根據媒體 Benzinga 報導，特斯拉(TSLA-US)在由汽車製造商、豪華車廠商及休閒車生產商組成的汽車產業中營運。儘管同業競爭激烈，特斯拉在多項關鍵估值指標上均居整體產業群組之冠，顯示出資本市場給予其極高的溢價與期待。
Benzinga 提出的估值數據顯示，按當前股價計算，特斯拉的本益比(P/E)高達 422.7 倍，遠高於整體汽車產業中位數的 26.3 倍，明顯超越豪華跑車品牌法拉利(Ferrari)的 37.9 倍。
在股價淨值比(P/B)方面，特斯拉達到 17.0 倍，高於產業中位數的 1.2 倍以及法拉利的 16.2 倍。此外，特斯拉的股價營收比(P/S)來到 13.1 倍，同樣遠高於產業中位數的 0.4 倍與法拉利的 8.5 倍。
這些指標凸顯，特斯拉在資本市場上的估值結構，遠高於傳統車廠如通用汽車(GM-US)及同業基準。
在獲利能力方面，Benzinga 報導指出，特斯拉在過去 12 個月中展現出高於同業平均的毛利率與營業利益率。其毛利率達到 19.3%，優於產業中位數的 9.2%；營業利益率為 3.5%，高於產業中位數的 2.1%；淨利率則達到 3.1%，亦領先產業中位數的 1.5%。
綜合來看，特斯拉雖然在毛利率與營業利益率等營運指標上優於傳統汽車產業平均，但其本益比與股價淨值比等估值指標甚至超越了法拉利等頂級豪華車品牌。
paras_en: According to media outlet Benzinga, Tesla (TSLA-US) operates within the automotive industry, which includes automobile manufacturers, luxury car makers, and recreational vehicle producers. Despite intense competition, Tesla tops the overall industry group on several key valuation metrics, indicating that the capital markets assign it a very high premium and expectations.

Benzinga’s valuation data shows that, based on the current share price, Tesla’s price‑earnings ratio (P/E) is a staggering 422.7 times, far above the industry median of 26.3 times and clearly surpassing luxury sports‑car brand Ferrari’s 37.9 times.

On a price‑to‑book basis (P/B), Tesla reaches 17.0 times, higher than the industry median of 1.2 times and also above Ferrari’s 16.2 times. In addition, Tesla’s price‑to‑sales ratio (P/S) stands at 13.1 times, again far exceeding the industry median of 0.4 times and Ferrari’s 8.5 times.
These figures highlight that Tesla’s valuation structure in the capital markets is much higher than that of traditional automakers such as General Motors (GM-US) and other industry benchmarks.

Regarding profitability, Benzinga reports that over the past 12 months Tesla has posted gross margin and operating margin levels above the industry average. Its gross margin is 19.3%, better than the industry median of 9.2%; operating margin is 3.5%, above the median of 2.1%; and net margin is 3.1%, also leading the industry median of 1.5%.

Overall, while Tesla outperforms the average traditional automotive industry on operating metrics such as gross and operating margins, its valuation multiples like P/E and P/B even exceed those of top‑tier luxury brands such as Ferrari.

paras_en: November 27, 2026 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – London Metal Exchange (LME) three‑month copper futures rebounded on the 27th. Reuters pricing shows that as of 11:30 a.m. Taipei time, copper futures were up 3.76% at $12,318 per metric ton. While copper futures recovered, the Chinese import copper premium fell below last week’s peak and Shanghai Futures Exchange copper inventories kept increasing.

Shanghai Nonferrous Metals Network (SMM) data shows that on the 27th the average premium for bonded warehouse copper imported through Yangshan held steady at $320 per metric ton, a 36% drop from the $500 level on the 19th. SMM also tallied that as of the 26th, spot inventories in China’s major regions grew by 9,100 metric tons week‑over‑week to over 60,000 metric tons. Shanghai’s inventories were replenished by incoming imported copper, while Guangdong’s stocks fell to their lowest level of the year; overall spot inventories remain about 110,000 metric tons lower than the same period last year.

Near‑month supply in Shanghai remains tight. Reuters pricing at the same time shows that the most actively traded January copper contract is priced RMB 2,310 per metric ton lower than the December contract. The next factor to watch is whether the near‑far month price spread for Shanghai copper will also narrow after imported copper arrives at the port.
